due_time.name: due_time
due_time.value: "tasks"."dueTime" is null or ("tasks"."dueDate" is not null and "tasks"."dueTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

start_time.name: start_time
start_time.value: "tasks"."startTime" is null or ("tasks"."startDate" is not null and "tasks"."startTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
